js: (() => { const cv = document.getElementById('isoCanvas'), b = cv.getBoundingClientRect(), insp = document.getElementById('inspector'), c = document.getElementById('__demo_cursor'); for (let y = b.top + 24; y < b.bottom - 10; y += 14) for (let x = b.left + 24; x < b.right - 10; x += 14) { cv.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointermove', { bubbles: true, clientX: x, clientY: y })); if (insp.querySelector('.insp-grid')) { if (c) { c.style.transform = 'translate(' + (x - 5) + 'px,' + (y - 3) + 'px)'; window.__cursor = { x, y }; } return { x: Math.round(x), y: Math.round(y) }; } } return null; })()
